name: Spear Sphere
description: Multiplayer caveman spear-throwing on a tiny planet. Ooga booga.

MODE.description: Starting mode: dotime (stone age to the end of the world, with armor), classic (Forever Stone) or coop (Tribe vs Bots: all humans against waves of bots).

ERA_SECONDS.description: Seconds in each Do Time age. After the last one, a random natural disaster ends the round.

BOT_LEVEL.description: Starting bot brains, 1-10: 1 wanders around and lags, 5 is a fair fight, 10 barely misses.

BOTS.description: Bots fill the planet up to this many cavemen (0-10, 0 = humans only).

MAX_PLAYERS.description: Most human players allowed on the planet at once.
